integrity: Exact proof and a deterministic standalone verifier are supplied. Direct computational checks are evidence for finite cases only.
scientific_limitations: Only induced line graphs of subcubic finite trees are in scope. Equality given fixed branch forest is sufficient, not a complete characterization of all coincidences; exhaustive minimality applies through six vertices. Historical priority is provisional, and no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Branch-forest collapse of one-point type spectra over subcubic tree line graphs
